title: Model object type v1
description: config/model/types/<ID>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1, docs/programs/padrao-dev/solucao.md): one kind of object of the engineering model, the system that manages it, its life-cycle states and what an object of it needs to be covered. scripts/lib/model.py validates every type file against this schema and checks what the schema cannot state (the id equals the file name, the system and the link types exist).

id.description: The type id, equal to the file name; objects of the type have ids `<ID>-...` or `<ID>:...`.

name.description: What an object of this type is, in a few words.

system.description: The id of the system (config/model/systems/) that manages the objects of this type.

derived_states.description: States computed from links, never written by hand.

inactive_states.description: States that take an object out of the active inventory (superseded, obsolete, retired).

covered_by.description: An active object of this type is covered when, for each entry, some object of `type` points to it with `link`.
